gates.evidence: The proposal targets the AOL account sidebar (s11) which contains general news navigation and account management, entirely SFW.
Rewards playing a 15s mini-game for storage slots; no rewards for clicks, installs, or cash-like items.
Existing saved articles remain fully accessible; new saves are blocked at 50, avoiding data loss threats or hostage framing.
User taps explicit CTA 'Play Now' in the offer modal.
States exact reward (+5 slots) and required action (15s game) before opt-in.
Includes an equally legible 'No thanks' decline button which dismisses the offer without penalty.
AOL is a news reading app; offers appear in the sidebar (s11), never interrupting AI streams.
Targeted strictly to logged-in free tier users.

scores.evidence: AOL is a general news reader where article saving is normally unlimited; article saving limits and slot refills are weakly connected to urgent user intent.
The proposal requires a product change that removes free value (removesFreeValue: true), capping previously unlimited free article saves at 50 slots.
Partial expansion (+5 slots per ad, capped at 3/day) for non-payers while subscription keeps unlimited storage; holdout planned.
COGS is zero (storage capacity limit), well below net revenue per view ($0.009–$0.015).
Saving articles is an occasional or rare action for most general news readers, resulting in low trigger frequency.
Maps to SIM-RWD unit, button entry, and sidebar screen s11, though requires adding storage quota tracking.
Fails grounding code gate because economy items 'ARTICLE_SAVE' and 'SAVE_CAPACITY' do not exist in the AOL digest.
Capped at 3 per day with a 60-minute cooldown and no re-offer after decline.
Defines primary metric (Total saved articles), guardrails, and a 10% user holdout for 4 weeks.

requiredChanges: Remove the artificial article save limit, as capping previously unlimited free storage in a news app destroys free value and harms product trust.

Re-anchor the rewarded ad exchange to an actual scarcity or feature in AOL (such as offline news digests, audio article listening minutes, or ad-free reading sessions) rather than inventing a storage capacity limit.
Fix economy grounding by referencing valid economy items or aligning with the observed product model.
parsed.topConcern: Artificial capping of free article storage in a news app removes existing free value and creates negative user friction for a low-frequency feature.
